paragraphs.text: Jennifer Clarke Wilkes is a senior editor and author. She worked for the Creative Department of Wizards of the Coast and Hasbro from May 1995 until January 2015.

Clarke Wilkes is an acclaimed RPG writer, editor, and designer with over 50 roleplaying sourcebooks to her credit. She's been a part of the industry since 1994's Vampire: The Masquerade . Since then, she has gone on to contribute to Ars Magica , D&D , both 3rd and 3.5 editions, and D20 sourcebooks.
Story arc and world-building: Weatherlight Saga , Mirrodin , Kamigawa and Lorwyn .
Magic short fiction: a.o. Rath and Storm , many online articles
